chancery_scale.FlavorText: The first time each turn you apply Paperwork to an enemy already 5 deep, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

pawnbrokers_loupe.FlavorText: Whenever a normal card reward is generated, one random card is Appraised: take it and gain 12 Gold. Skip the entire reward and gain 6 Gold.

copper_receipt_roll.FlavorText: Your attacks deal 25% more damage. Attacks against you deal 25% more damage.

secondhand_reliquary.FlavorText: The first time each Act you enter a Shop, one Normal Relic for sale is Secondhand: it costs 30% less, and buying it costs 5 HP.

bounty_hook.FlavorText: After defeating an Elite, gain 20 Gold — or 35 if you finished that combat below half your Max HP.

witchmarket_purse.FlavorText: Every attack hit against you deals 1 less damage. Every Block you gain is 1 less.

bent_auction_gavel.FlavorText: Whenever a random Normal Relic is offered as a reward, you may reject it and gain 65 Gold instead. Boss, Event and purchased relics are excluded.

wastebrokers_permit.FlavorText: Whenever you Archive a card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.

filing_fee_stamp.FlavorText: At combat end, each enemy that died with 5+ Paperwork grants 6 Gold, and 4 more if it died with 10+. At most 20 Gold per combat.

scriveners_shears.FlavorText: The first card removal you buy each Act costs 50% less; the next one that Act costs 25% more.

apprentices_whetstone.FlavorText: Whenever you purchase a card, you may pay 20 additional Gold to upgrade it immediately.

backroom_kettle.FlavorText: Once per Shop visit, pay 25 Gold to heal 8 HP.

crooked_display_case.FlavorText: Adds one additional Normal Relic to this Shop and to every future Shop. The extra relic costs 20% more.

turnover_bell.FlavorText: Once per Shop visit, pay 30 Gold to replace all unsold cards with new ones. Relics and services are unaffected.

debtors_signet.FlavorText: You may buy what you cannot afford; the remainder becomes Debt, up to 100. While in Debt, half of any Gold you gain, rounded up, repays it.

notarys_waiver.FlavorText: Whenever you Ratify, gain 1 Waiver, up to 4. Each Waiver takes 10 Gold off a card removal, and buying one spends them all.

priority_window_pass.FlavorText: Whenever a Queued card resolves, apply 2 Paperwork to ALL enemies.

twin_lock_chest_key.FlavorText: Whenever a Normal Relic is offered, two are revealed and you choose one.

appraisers_chalk.FlavorText: Whenever a normal card reward is generated, one of its cards is offered upgraded.

guest_favor_token.FlavorText: The first time each Act you resolve an Event, choose 25 Gold or upgrade a card in your deck.

merchant_punchcard.FlavorText: Your first turn each combat has 2 less Energy. Every later turn, gain 1 Energy.

warranty_tag.FlavorText: When picked up, lose 7 Max HP. Start each combat with 2 Strength.

indemnity_stamp.FlavorText: Every card reward shows one more card to choose from. Everything in a Shop costs 10% more.

archive_voucher_roll.FlavorText: Whenever you Ratify an enemy, apply 1 Doubt and 2 Paperwork to it.

departmental_purchase_order.FlavorText: Whenever you apply Doubt, apply 1 more.

originality_stamp.FlavorText: Once per combat, the first non-Junk card you play is copied into your hand, and your next card costs 1 less.

unclaimed_property_tag.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, one card in your draw pile costs 1 less this fight.

uncalled_ticket.FlavorText: Once per combat, a card still in your hand at the end of your turn goes back on top of your draw pile; next turn you gain 1 Energy and draw 1.

threshold_ward.FlavorText: Start each combat with 6 Block. The first time an enemy gains a positive status each combat, gain 1 Energy and 6 Block.

crossed_out_map.FlavorText: Once, you may walk to any node in the next row, ignoring the paths.

inherited_bone_folder.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, one card in your draw pile costs 1 less this fight, and you draw 1 extra card.

unreturned_library_card.FlavorText: Once each combat, a card you end your turn still holding is waiting in your hand next turn, and it is free.

reversible_shelf_label.FlavorText: Once each combat, the label remembers a card you put down unplayed. When it next reaches your hand you draw 1 and it costs 1 less.

blank_cameo.FlavorText: At each combat's opening one card in your hand is kept, costs 1 less, and cannot be marked by the archive.

vow_bead.FlavorText: End a turn having played exactly 3 non-Junk cards and your next turn gains 1 Energy and 1 card.

inverted_sealstone.FlavorText: At each combat's opening one Deed or Working is sealed: the first time you play it, it comes back to your hand.

mootcap.FlavorText: The third real card you play each turn is put to the circle, and it answers: 10 Block, a card, or 7 damage to everything standing.

dissenting_spore.FlavorText: An odd turn grows a spore and an even one costs you one. At three, the ring speaks: 1 Energy, an extra card and 6 Block.

antway_marker.FlavorText: Three real cards in a row, none cheaper than the one before: the third is worth 1 Energy and a card. Step out of order and the line is broken for the turn.

complaint_leaf.FlavorText: The first party to lay a hand on you is named the Respondent. While it is standing, one card in your hand each turn costs 1 less.

guest_right_brooch.FlavorText: You have been welcomed. Every combat opens with 8 Block and 1 Safe-Conduct.

cup_of_the_lowest_mark.FlavorText: The first turn each fight you end with exactly one Energy unspent: heal 4, and one more card at your next hand.

red_linen_knot.FlavorText: Every fight opens with 8 Block, and the first time an affliction is held on you instead of fading you are wrapped again for 8.

blank_cartouche.FlavorText: An extra card in your first hand. The first Burdened you gain each fight finds no name to be written under and comes off again.

jar_of_borrowed_breath.FlavorText: The first affliction to leave you completely each fight is breath given back: heal 3, and one more card at your next hand.

broken_royal_weight.FlavorText: Every fight opens with 10 Block. The first measure you miss is taken on the weight instead: 10 Block at your next hand, and one Burdened.

petition_chisel.FlavorText: Every enemy action that marks you is one Grievance, at most 3. At the start of a turn with 3: draw 2, take a Spare Hand, and one affliction loses a stack.

tablet_of_the_missing_name.FlavorText: Every fight opens with one Nameless Authority: the first blessing you gain lands one stack larger.

funerary_linen_coil.FlavorText: The first card each fight you put out of the fight yourself — archived, exhausted, banished, never merely played — heals 4 and draws 1. Junk is not worth the linen.

mercy_counterweight.FlavorText: At your first hand each fight, choose a pan: mercy, and the first affliction lands one stack lighter; or payment, and it pays a Spare Hand and a card at your next hand.

unfinished_docket.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, store up to 1 unspent Energy. You gain it next turn.

red_ribboned_matter.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, keep 1 card in hand. It costs 1 less next turn.

backlog_counterseal.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, gain 4 Block for each card left in your hand, up to 8.

brass_service_bell.FlavorText: At the start of every second turn, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

priority_sash.FlavorText: The first time each turn you deal 15 or more damage, gain 8 Block.

ivory_number_disc.FlavorText: Two enemy turns in a row without losing HP: gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

access_seal_shard.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 extra card.

testimony_seal_shard.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 8 Block and refuse the first negative status applied to you.

execution_seal_shard.FlavorText: Your first Deed each turn deals 4 additional damage.

stamped_expedition_writ.FlavorText: Once per combat, when you run out of Energy with cards in hand, gain 2 Energy.

civic_entry_warrant.FlavorText: Once per combat, when you run out of Energy with cards in hand, gain 1 Energy and strip every enemy's Block.

inspectors_brass_charter.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 8 Block.

continuance_fragment.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, up to 8 Block carries into your next turn.

right_of_redress.FlavorText: The first time you have lost 12 HP in a combat, your next turn opens with 15 Block and 2 cards.

margin_of_appeal.FlavorText: Once per combat, the enemies' next turn is appealed: they deal half damage.

errata_ribbon.FlavorText: Play 3+ cards or fewer than 3 — change from last turn for 1 Energy, repeat it for 6 Block.

index_of_contradictions.FlavorText: The first time each turn you play a card of a different type than the one before, draw 1 and gain 3 Block.

registry_tab.FlavorText: The type you played most on turn 1 is registered: its first card each turn costs 1 less.

custody_shackle.FlavorText: End a turn having played 2 cards or fewer and 1 card stays in hand, free next turn.

master_release_key.FlavorText: On turn 1, seal a card of your choice in hand. Next turn it costs 0.

release_tag.FlavorText: After each draw, 1 card in hand costs 1 less and gains you 4 Block when played.

misdated_pocket_watch.FlavorText: Your last turn pays this one: no cards → 8 Block, 1–2 → 1 Energy, 3+ → draw 1.

borrowed_minute.FlavorText: Borrow 1 Energy at the start of a turn; the next turn repays it and gains 4 Block.

deferred_appointment_book.FlavorText: Turn 2: draw 2. Turn 3: gain 2 Energy. Turn 4: gain 15 Block.

identity_writ.FlavorText: The first time each turn you play a second card of the same type, draw 1. If you never do, gain 5 Block at the end of the turn.

settled_ledger.FlavorText: Every 4 Energy you spend on cards returns 1 Energy.

closure_writ.FlavorText: After winning a combat, heal a quarter of the health you are missing, up to 10.

premise_slip.FlavorText: Your first card each turn is a premise: cards of other types cost 1 less until you follow it, and following it in kind gains 6 Block.

concordance_thread.FlavorText: After each draw, 1 card in hand is threaded: playing it draws a card that costs 1 less this turn.

conclusion_leaf.FlavorText: The last card type you played decides your next turn: Deed → your first Deed deals 8 more, Working → 8 Block, Rite → draw 1.

boundary_tally.FlavorText: The road and the root take it in turns: on a road turn your first real card costs 1 less, on a root turn you open with 10 Block.

counter_petition_twine.FlavorText: Once a turn you may re-argue a card: discard one, draw one, and gain 1 Energy.

signed_settlement.FlavorText: Come through an enemy turn untouched for 1 Energy and a card; come through it hurt for 8 Block.

countersealed_ring_of_passage.FlavorText: Your first real card each turn sets a price; the next card at that price is refunded. A turn with no match ends in 5 Block.

countersealed_ring_of_restraint.FlavorText: Play three real cards and the fourth is refunded and draws a card. A turn that never reaches three keeps the ring armed.

countersealed_ring_of_keeping.FlavorText: Empty your hand of real cards and the next turn opens with 1 Energy and two extra cards; keep something back and one card stays, cheaper.

honey_spoon.FlavorText: Once a turn you may take 2 Energy. End that turn with at least 1 Energy, or it costs you 6 HP.

better_chair_cushion.FlavorText: Once a turn you may take 14 Block. End that turn holding a real card, or it costs you 6 HP.

last_slice_tin.FlavorText: Once a turn you may draw 2. Play no more than four real cards that turn, or it costs you 6 HP.

surveyed_milestone.FlavorText: The largest thing on the field is a landmark: first bringing it past three quarters, half and a quarter grants 1 Energy and a card.

survey_cairn.FlavorText: End a turn with 12 Block or more and the cairn buries twelve of it; the next turn opens with 1 Energy and a card.

loadstone_cairn.FlavorText: What the enemies take out of you is weight in the stone: next turn it is Block, and it is on your first Deed. Up to 12.

royal_grace_cup.FlavorText: Once a turn the cup offers an Energy, a card or 10 Block. Take it and every enemy guards for 6.

hollow_court_token.FlavorText: Spending your purse to the bottom is remembered, up to three times; open a turn owed all three and it pays 1 Energy, two cards and 8 Block.

silver_name_tally.FlavorText: Once a combat: one enemy's guard is gone, you gain 10 Block against what it was about to do, and your next card that turn is refunded.

crown_of_the_three_names.FlavorText: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn. Every enemy starts each combat with 1 Strength.

edict_of_the_open_audience.FlavorText: Once a combat, every card in your hand is heard for nothing.

eternal_cartouche.FlavorText: The first blow that would end you does not: you stand again, clean of every affliction, and the cartouche is spent for good.

feather_of_perfect_measure.FlavorText: Whichever kind you lead with costs 1 less, and the first answer in the other kind draws 1 and gains 8 Block.

acquittal_scarab.FlavorText: Every third turn the court sits: enemy guards fall and you strike 30% harder. You read one judgment further ahead than anyone else.

balance_of_the_two_pans.FlavorText: End a turn with as many Deeds as Workings, one of each at least, to heal 2 and open the next turn with an Energy. An unbalanced turn ends in 12 Block.

impossible_capstone.FlavorText: Half of whatever Block you still hold at the end of a turn is still there at the start of the next.

pyramidion_of_repetition.FlavorText: Every sixth real card you play in a fight happens twice, and the second time is free.

crooked_plumb_line.FlavorText: The first time in a turn you follow a card with one of another kind, up to 2 Energy comes back. A turn that never bends ends in 10 Block.

black_granary_key.FlavorText: Energy you do not spend is stored, and it comes back the moment you run out.

granary_reserve_seal.FlavorText: Every fight you win puts 15 HP back.

ration_seal.FlavorText: The fourth real card of a turn is free and draws you another. A turn that never gets there ends in 10 Block.

palimpsest_reed.FlavorText: The first real card you play each turn is copied down; the copy is in your hand next turn, and it is free.

erasure_tablet.FlavorText: Once a combat you may erase what the enemies were about to do; they guard for 20 instead.

correction_reed.FlavorText: Once a turn you may correct the record: a card away, a card back out of the discard pile, and the one you take back comes cheaper.

canopic_cabinet.FlavorText: The fight opens with 12 Block, and the first two afflictions laid on you are refused outright.

resin_shroud.FlavorText: Once a fight, coming round below half your health strips every affliction and wraps you in 25 Block.

basin_of_black_natron.FlavorText: Each turn the basin washes a stack off one of your afflictions — or gives you 12 Block if you have none.

sluice_gate_of_the_two_lands.FlavorText: Once a turn you may work the gate: 12 Block into an Energy, or an Energy into 12 Block.

flood_reckoning_crown.FlavorText: How you ended decides how you open: dry, and the crown pays an Energy and a card; with something left, an Energy and 15 Block. The first turn opens with 10 Block.

black_flood_vessel.FlavorText: Once a combat you may pour the whole hand away and draw seven fresh ones, with 2 Energy to spend on them.

case_that_climbed.FlavorText: The first time an enemy falls each fight, gain 1 Energy and draw a card.

thrice_struck_appointment.FlavorText: Every third turn, draw one more card.

shutter_key_late_hour.FlavorText: End a turn having played nothing and the shutter pays for it: 12 Block and 1 Energy at your next hand.

chair_of_the_ninth_hour.FlavorText: Two more cards in your opening hand, and one fewer on the turn after.

contempt_ledger_nail.FlavorText: Every Censure you take is filed against the weakest enemy: 2 Paperwork.

inventory_lantern_glass.FlavorText: Every shop will strike one card from your deck for nothing.

gate_chain_counterweight.FlavorText: Deal 20 or more damage in one turn and your first card next turn costs 1 less.

cracked_bell_lip.FlavorText: The first Overdue filed against you each fight: 10 Block and a card.

roller_pin_of_the_stacks.FlavorText: The first card misfiled against you each fight is replaced.

blank_line_black_book.FlavorText: Every card reward shows one more card to choose from.

strip_of_censoring_ink.FlavorText: Every fight opens with 8 Block: the first blow is blacked out.

line_between_the_volumes.FlavorText: The second card you play each turn strikes 4 harder.

drawer_within_a_drawer.FlavorText: The first card you exhaust each fight comes back to your discard pile.

the_third_ending.FlavorText: Once each fight, the blow that would end you is struck through instead: you stand at 8.

pre_approved_antler_tine.FlavorText: The first Safe-Conduct you spend each fight is not spent.

mended_thread.FlavorText: Every fight opens with 1 Safe-Conduct, and spending one gives 3 Block.

toll_stone_wrong_bank.FlavorText: The first Claim laid on you each fight also gives 6 Block.

coin_left_in_the_throat.FlavorText: Every Claim laid on you leaves 2 Block behind, and every victory leaves 10 Gold.

head_of_the_line.FlavorText: Play three cards in a turn and the line is kept: draw 2.

obsolete_boundary_cord.FlavorText: Every turn in which something on you lapsed of its own accord: 3 Block.

thorn_chosen_from_three.FlavorText: At every opening hand, choose: 10 Block, a card and 1 Energy, or 6 damage to every enemy.

libation_bowl.FlavorText: Every fight opens with a Feather on you: your first attack deals 5 more.

sekhmets_claw.FlavorText: The first time you lose HP each fight, gain 2 Strength.

broken_granary_seal.FlavorText: The first time each fight you strike an enemy that is behind Block: 8 more damage.

cut_corvee_rope.FlavorText: Every third Burdened surcharge you pay gives 1 Energy back.

a_ring_put_back.FlavorText: What you did not keep keeps paying: every victory leaves 15 Gold.

overseers_linen_shears.FlavorText: The first thing that fades from you each fight: heal 3 and gain 3 Block.

riddles_third_answer.FlavorText: Every fight opens with 2 Ward Wax on you and 1 Seal on the enemy with the least health.

lamp_thiefs_wick.FlavorText: When an enemy falls, gain 2 Block for every enemy still standing.

decan_star_table_chip.FlavorText: Every sixth turn, one affliction leaves you.

processional_step_stone.FlavorText: Every third turn, your first card costs nothing.

tooth_from_the_false_lid_1.FlavorText: The first blow of every fight glances off the tooth: 4 Block. It comes with a splinter of the oak it grew through.

tooth_from_the_false_lid_2.FlavorText: The first blow of every fight glances off the tooth: 8 Block. It comes with a brass hinge, still screwed to it.

tooth_from_the_false_lid_3.FlavorText: The first blow of every fight glances off the tooth: 12 Block and heal 2. It comes with the lock-plate, its keyhole ringed with tooth-marks.

tooth_from_the_false_lid_4.FlavorText: The first blow of every fight glances off the tooth: 16 Block and heal 4. It comes with the whole false lid, folded shut around it like a jaw at rest.

rowan_pin.FlavorText: The first time each turn a card goes into the cauldron, gain 3 Block.

three_knot_cord.FlavorText: Whenever a Hex bursts, that enemy gains 1 Hexed.

found_button.FlavorText: Whenever a Misfortune roll fails, gain 4 Block.

greasy_ladle.FlavorText: Your first Brew each turn draws 1 card.

iron_trivet.FlavorText: If you end your turn with the cauldron Ready, gain 6 Block.

crows_toe.FlavorText: The first time each turn you hit an enemy whose Hex bursts at the end of its next turn, deal 5 more damage.

beeswax_cup.FlavorText: The first time each turn you are healed, gain 2 Ward Wax.

knucklebone_pair.FlavorText: The first time each turn a Misfortune roll fails, 2 Misfortune stays on that enemy.

false_bottom_pot.FlavorText: The cauldron takes a fourth card in reserve. It is not part of the Brew, and stays for the next one.

first_bell.FlavorText: The first time you Hex an enemy, its Threefold count starts a step ahead.

black_cats_collar.FlavorText: The first Misfortune roll that fails each turn is rolled again.

grandams_ember.FlavorText: Once each combat, Hearth healing may restore HP you lost before the fight.

bone_strainer.FlavorText: Dregs in a mixed Brew count as a family you name. They never make a concentrated one.

apothecarys_scale.FlavorText: Your first Brew each combat of three different families costs no Energy.

yesterdays_jar.FlavorText: After your first Brew each combat, the last ingredient stays in the cauldron.

cats_eye_coin.FlavorText: After winning a combat, gain 5 Gold for each Misfortune that landed in it, at most 15.

black_spoon.FlavorText: The first time each combat you brew a Hidden Recipe, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

herb_wifes_rack.FlavorText: Every Brew with a Hearth ingredient also heals 2 HP lost this combat.

ar_sooty_ferrule.FlavorText: Once per turn, after a cast in which a direct wand hit spent Singe, gain 1 Focus.

ar_knotted_wristcord.FlavorText: After your first cast each turn that ran 1 or 2 wand cards, you may take one of them back into your hand for free.

ar_pencil_box.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Rote.

ar_blue_inkstone.FlavorText: Once per turn, when Flow would return Focus after a cast, up to 2 of it may lower Exhaustion by 1 each instead.

ar_bent_nib.FlavorText: Once per turn, right after you inscribe a card, it may trade places with a neighbouring wand card for free — with any wand card, if a Gust resolved this turn.

ar_wire_spectacles.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Poise and 1 Focus.

ar_sand_glass.FlavorText: At the start of your turn, if the wand holds 3 or more cards, gain 1 Focus.

ar_brass_dividers.FlavorText: Once per turn, you may cast any run of neighbouring slots instead of the whole wand. It costs Focus for what it runs.

ar_ash_bookcord.FlavorText: Once per turn, after a wand card is exhausted by Burn or Burn Out, you may inscribe a card from your hand into its slot for free.

ar_star_chart.FlavorText: The first time you cast each turn, gain 1 Rote.

ar_tutors_cane.FlavorText: The wand starts each combat with one more slot.

ar_feather_catcher.FlavorText: Once per turn, one of the cards your Gust would discard may be inscribed into a free slot instead, for free.

ar_chalked_thumbstall.FlavorText: The first time each enemy turn Grit softens an attack, your next cast's Exhaustion is 2 lower.

ar_bone_spacer.FlavorText: Once per turn, the first cast that crosses an empty slot between two cards gives its next Speak 25% more, and 1 more Exhaustion.

ar_spare_wicks.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 2 Singe to ALL enemies.

ar_slate_board.FlavorText: Whenever you inscribe a card, gain 2 Block.

ar_oil_lamp.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, if you did not cast, gain 1 Focus.

lt_relic_tin_fife.FlavorText: The first time each turn you issue an Order, draw 1 card, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your draw pile.

lt_relic_chipped_buckler.FlavorText: The first time each turn a Deed of yours hits a Challenged enemy, gain 4 Block.

lt_relic_split_chinstrap.FlavorText: Once each enemy phase, when an enemy hit spends your Open Guard and takes none of your HP, gain 1 Authority at the start of your next turn.

lt_relic_sword_knot.FlavorText: The first time each turn you spend Strength on a card, gain 1 Authority.

lt_relic_warrant_cord.FlavorText: Once each turn, when your Challenge ends because its target fell before you kept it, gain 1 Authority.

lt_relic_parade_spur.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, if you have Open Guard, you may gain 1 more. If you do and an enemy attacks you before your next turn, gain 1 Authority when it comes.

lt_relic_pay_chest.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, if you have 3 or more Authority, gain 5 Block.

lt_relic_dented_gorget.FlavorText: Once each enemy phase, when an enemy hit spends your Open Guard, your first Deed next turn costs 1 less.

lt_relic_torn_standard.FlavorText: Once each turn, when an Order fails at its deadline and you have no Challenge out, Challenge the weakest enemy: hit it with a Deed by the end of your next turn (1 Authority).

lt_relic_full_tang.FlavorText: The first time each turn you spend Strength on a card, deal 6 damage to the weakest enemy for each Strength spent (at most 3).

lt_relic_scarlet_epaulette.FlavorText: The first time each turn you gain Open Guard, your next Deed this turn strikes its target once more for half of its blow.

lt_relic_commission.FlavorText: Begin each combat with 1 Authority. After a victory, keep up to 2 Authority you have left for the start of the next combat.

lt_relic_lead_knuckles.FlavorText: Once each turn, when you play a Deed with Open Guard, you may Exhaust another card from your hand to deal 8 more damage to its target.

lt_relic_iron_shackle.FlavorText: The first time each turn you issue a Challenge, you may gain 1 Open Guard to apply 2 Doubt to its target.

lt_relic_brandy_flask.FlavorText: After a victorious combat, heal half the HP Open Guard cost you in it (at most 6).

lt_relic_badge_chain.FlavorText: Once each turn, when you keep a Challenge, you may turn 1 of the Authority it gave you into 1 Strength.

lt_relic_worn_epaulette.FlavorText: The first time each turn you keep an Order, your next Working costs 1 less, this turn or the next.

lt_relic_spur_buckle.FlavorText: Once each turn, after a card spends your Strength, you may spend 1 more Strength to gain 1 Energy.

trial_infirmary.FlavorText: Encounter Trial only: after every fight you win, heal to full.

paperwork.FlavorText: At the end of the enemy turn, this character loses HP equal to its Paperwork. This ignores Block.

doubt.FlavorText: The next attack made by this character deals 25% less damage. One stack is removed when this triggers.

panic.FlavorText: At the start of the player's turn, draw 1 fewer card. One stack is removed when this triggers.

fatigue.FlavorText: At the start of the player's turn, lose 1 Energy. One stack is removed when this triggers.

strength.FlavorText: This character's attacks deal additional damage equal to its Strength.

bookworm.FlavorText: Immediately before this enemy's Paperwork resolves, remove up to X Paperwork from it and the same number of Bookworm stacks. Bookworm remains if there is no Paperwork.

poison.FlavorText: At the end of the enemy turn, loses HP equal to Poison, then Poison is reduced by 1.

ant_queen_of_the_proper_line.FlavorText: Ant Queen of the Proper Line

ombudsman_of_root_and_road.FlavorText: The Ombudsman of Root and Road

nisaba_keeper_of_the_first_tablet.FlavorText: Nisaba, Lady of the Reed Stylus, Who Writes What Must Come

inanna_mistress_of_the_eanna_ledger.FlavorText: Inanna, Queen of Heaven, Who Descended to the Great Below

nanshe_keeper_of_the_just_ration.FlavorText: Nanshe, Lady of the Just Measure, Who Reads the Dreams of Kings

nanna_sin_lord_of_the_counted_moon.FlavorText: Nanna-Suen, Lord of the Counted Moon, Father of the Sun and the Morning Star

utu_witness_of_every_oath.FlavorText: Utu-Shamash, Judge of Heaven and Earth, Witness of Every Oath

enlil_voice_of_the_unalterable_decree.FlavorText: Enlil, Lord of the Wind, Whose Word Cannot Be Unspoken

city_elite_delay_03.FlavorText: The Waiting Room Eats the Day

city_normal_delay_08.FlavorText: The Hour Has Not Been Called

archives_necrology_02.FlavorText: The Last Will of Nobody in Particular

archives_necrology_duo_02.FlavorText: The Will Is Kept in a Jar

green_docket_road_duo_02.FlavorText: The Path Points Past the Hare

green_docket_elite_ant_queen_of_the_prop.FlavorText: Ant Queen of the Proper Line

green_docket_boss_ombudsman_of_root_and_.FlavorText: The Ombudsman of Root and Road

Extra.divineRule: What she writes happens. Each sentence stands beside her as a body with a countdown: break it in time and it is erased, or it comes true. At 30 % only the Final Line is left — and it erases you.
She comes down wearing the seven regalia of the Descent. Every 130 HP she loses she passes a gate, and you choose which of them she leaves there. With the last one gone she is the Queen of Battle.
Every day has its portion: 3 Energy and 5 cards. What you take from tomorrow comes off the next day, never below 1 and 1, and what is still owed after Day III is collected: 10 a point.

A fixed ring of four phases, one a round: New Moon, Waxing, Full Moon, Waning. Each phase has one move and one rule; the phase now and the next are on him. Every orbit he completes makes him brighter.
Each turn three oaths are in your hand; the Block is paid at once. Deal him less than you swore and he gains a Witness. His Saw of Judgment returns half of what you dealt him the turn before.
Eight decrees in a ring; exactly one is in force each round, and the next is always announced. Every decree binds him as it binds you, and nothing removes, shortens or changes one.

Extra.compendium.plain:energy: What you spend to play cards. You get it back at the start of every turn.
Extra.compendium.example:energy: You have 3 Energy. Paper Cut costs 1 and Permit A38 costs 2: you can play both this turn, and then nothing else.
Extra.compendium.plain:block: Armour for one round. Damage takes Block away before it takes HP, and Block you did not use is gone at the start of your next turn.
Extra.compendium.example:block: You have 7 Block and an enemy attacks for 10: the Block is used up and you lose 3 HP.
Extra.compendium.plain:intent: What an enemy will do on its next turn, shown under its health bar: the move's name, then what it does.
Extra.compendium.example:intent: "Enter the Premises · ⚔ 9" means that enemy will attack you for 9 when you end your turn.
Extra.compendium.plain:exhaust: A card that Exhausts leaves your deck for the rest of the fight after it is played. It comes back next fight.
Extra.compendium.example:exhaust: Candle Allowance says Exhaust: play it once, and it will not be drawn again until the next combat.
Extra.compendium.plain:rite: A card that sets up a lasting effect for the rest of the fight. Rites Exhaust, so each one works once per fight.
Extra.compendium.example:rite: Play Ash Register: from now on, the first card you Archive each turn draws you a card — until the fight ends.
Extra.compendium.plain:deed: A card whose main job is to hurt an enemy. Some effects only care about Deeds.
Extra.compendium.example:deed: Paper Cut is a Deed. Against a Ratified enemy, every hit of a Deed deals double damage.
Extra.compendium.plain:working: A card that defends, sets things up or bends the rules, rather than dealing damage directly.
Extra.compendium.example:working: Cower Behind a Desk is a Working: it gives you Block and never touches the enemy.
Extra.compendium.plain:queue: A Queue card does not happen when you play it — it is filed, and resolves later, in the order it was filed.
Extra.compendium.example:queue: Deferred Hex says "Queue: Deal 13 damage." You play it now for 1 Energy; the 13 damage lands when the queue reaches it.
Extra.compendium.plain:archive: To Archive a card is to take it out of your hand and put it away for the fight, on purpose. Some cards and relics reward you for it.
Extra.compendium.example:archive: Certified Kindling: Archive a card from your hand and gain 6 Block. Archive a Junk card and you gain 5 more.
Extra.compendium.plain:junk: Useless paperwork that clogs your deck. Some enemies and events add it; Archiving it is often the best use.
Extra.compendium.example:junk: An enemy adds Red Tape to your discard pile. When you draw it, it takes a slot in your hand and cannot be played.
Extra.compendium.plain:retain: A retained card stays in your hand at the end of your turn instead of being discarded.
Extra.compendium.example:retain: Keep a Retain card for the turn the big attack comes, and play it then.
Extra.compendium.plain:upgrade: An improved card (a "+" after its name) is a stronger version of itself. Right-click a card in a shop, a reward or your deck to see its improved form.
Extra.compendium.example:upgrade: Form of Ill Intent applies 6 Paperwork; Form of Ill Intent+ applies 9.
Extra.compendium.plain:form: A card marked "Form." is an official paper. It plays like any other card, but some relics reward Forms.
Extra.compendium.example:form: Permit A38 is a Form: with Formkeeper's Signet, the first Form you play each turn also gives 2 Block.
Extra.compendium.plain:relic_words: Some relics speak in older words. A real card is any card that is not Junk. An affliction is a negative status on you, a blessing a positive one. An enemy's guard is its Block.
Extra.compendium.example:relic_words: "The third real card you play each turn": Junk you play does not count towards the three.
Extra.compendium.plain:paperwork: Damage over time that goes straight past Block and never wears off on its own.
Extra.compendium.example:paperwork: An enemy with 5 Paperwork loses 5 HP at the end of each of its turns — every turn, until the fight ends.
Extra.compendium.plain:doubt: Makes attacks weaker: each attack with Doubt deals a quarter less damage and uses up one Doubt.
Extra.compendium.example:doubt: An enemy with 2 Doubt attacks for 12: it deals 9, and has 1 Doubt left for its next attack.
Extra.compendium.plain:seal: Collects towards Ratified: at 3 Seal, 3 are used up and the enemy becomes Ratified.
Extra.compendium.example:seal: An enemy has 2 Seal and you apply 2 more: it is Ratified, and 1 Seal is left over for next time.
Extra.compendium.plain:ratified: Until the end of your turn, every hit of a Deed aimed at a Ratified enemy deals double damage.
Extra.compendium.example:ratified: Ratify an enemy, then play three Paper Cuts at it: each deals 12 instead of 6.
Extra.compendium.plain:citation: Punishes an enemy for doing anything that is not an attack: it loses HP equal to its Citation, then one Citation.
Extra.compendium.example:citation: An enemy with 3 Citation blocks instead of attacking: it loses 3 HP and drops to 2 Citation.
Extra.compendium.plain:lien: Eats an enemy's leftover Block at the end of each of its turns, and takes the same amount of HP. Lien on an enemy never runs out.
Extra.compendium.example:lien: An enemy has 10 Lien and ends its turn with 10 Block: it loses 10 Block and 10 HP — and keeps its 10 Lien for next time.
Extra.compendium.plain:strength: Each stack makes every attack of that character deal 1 more damage.
Extra.compendium.example:strength: An enemy with 2 Strength whose move says ⚔ 6 hits you for 8.
Extra.compendium.plain:panic: You draw fewer cards: one fewer per stack at the start of your turn. One stack fades each turn.
Extra.compendium.example:panic: With 2 Panic you draw 3 cards instead of 5 next turn, and 4 the turn after.
Extra.compendium.plain:burdened: Every card costs 1 more Energy. Each time you pay that extra, one stack is worked off.
Extra.compendium.example:burdened: With 2 Burdened, your first two cards each cost 1 more; after that, cards cost their normal price again.
Extra.compendium.plain:fatigue: You start your turn with 1 less Energy. One stack fades each turn.
Extra.compendium.example:fatigue: With 1 Fatigue you have 2 Energy next turn instead of 3.
Extra.compendium.plain:poison: Damage over time that ignores Block, then shrinks by one each turn.
Extra.compendium.example:poison: 5 Poison: you lose 5 HP, then 4, then 3 … over the next turns.
Extra.compendium.plain:trespass: A law you broke. The enemy whose law it was gains a Claim at once.
Extra.compendium.example:trespass: You play a Deed before any Working against the Permit Hare: it gains a Claim.
Extra.compendium.plain:safe_conduct: A pass that forgives the next law you break: no Claim.
Extra.compendium.example:safe_conduct: With 1 Safe-Conduct, the next law you break costs nothing and the Safe-Conduct is spent.
Extra.compendium.plain:claim: Won by an enemy each time you break its law: each adds 7 to its attacks. Nobody holds more than 3.
Extra.compendium.example:claim: You break the Hare's law twice: it holds 2 Claims, and its attacks deal 6 more.
Extra.compendium.plain:overdue: A debt to whoever gave it to you. At 2 from the same source, that source collects its price.
Extra.compendium.example:overdue: An enemy gives you Overdue twice: at 2 it collects, as its rules describe.
Extra.compendium.plain:entombed: Burial pressure that builds up. At 5 you lose your whole next turn, and 5 are used up.
Extra.compendium.example:entombed: You are at 4 Entombed and an enemy adds 1: your next turn is skipped.
Extra.compendium.plain:weighed: This turn you must spend exactly this much Energy. The further you are from it, the worse the answer.
Extra.compendium.example:weighed: Weighed 3 and you spend only 2 Energy: you missed the measure by 1.
Extra.compendium.plain:ward_wax: Gives you Block at the start of each turn. It shrinks after the enemy turn — faster if an attack got through.
Extra.compendium.example:ward_wax: With 4 Ward Wax you start your turn with 4 extra Block.
Extra.compendium.plain:blood_ink: Whenever any other status on this character shrinks, it loses HP equal to its Blood Ink, then one Blood Ink.
Extra.compendium.example:blood_ink: An enemy with 3 Blood Ink uses up a Doubt: it loses 3 HP, and has 2 Blood Ink left.
Extra.compendium.plain:archived: Counts how many cards you have Archived this fight. Some cards grow stronger with it.
Extra.compendium.example:archived: You have Archived 3 cards: a card that deals "5 damage for each card you have Archived" deals 15.
Extra.compendium.plain:cauldron: The Hedge Witch's pot. Instead of playing a card she may put it in; with three cards inside she can Brew them.
Extra.compendium.example:cauldron: Her pot holds Adder's Nip and Pot-Lid. One more card and it is Ready to brew.
Extra.compendium.plain:into_the_pot: Her action, not a card: put a card from your hand into the cauldron instead of playing it. The first each turn costs nothing, every further one 1 Energy. It does not count as playing a card.
Extra.compendium.example:into_the_pot: She puts Crooked Finger in for free, then Two Teeth for 1 Energy: two cards in the pot, and no card played this turn.
Extra.compendium.plain:brew: Her action: with three cards in the cauldron, pay 1 Energy and brew them. What they make depends on their families; afterwards they go to your discard pile.
Extra.compendium.example:brew: Two Fang and a Husk in the pot: Brew deals 10 damage and gives 4 Block, and the three cards are discarded.
Extra.compendium.plain:ingredient_family: Each of her cards is one of five ingredients: Fang (damage), Hex (Hexed), Husk (Block), Hearth (healing) or Fortune (Misfortune). In a mixed brew each card gives its family's share.
Extra.compendium.example:ingredient_family: In a mixed brew a Fang gives 5 damage, a Hex 2 Hexed, a Husk 4 Block, a Hearth heals 1, a Fortune 3 Misfortune.
Extra.compendium.plain:concentrated_brew: Three cards of ONE family make that family's own strong brew instead of three small shares.
Extra.compendium.example:concentrated_brew: Three Fang: Red Teeth, 18 damage — more than the 15 three Fang shares would give.
Extra.compendium.plain:dregs: A card without a family — Junk, mostly — still fills a slot in the pot, but gives nothing to the brew.
Extra.compendium.example:dregs: A Mirror Shard, an Adder's Nip and a Pot-Lid: the brew deals 5 and gives 4 Block; the shard adds nothing.
Extra.compendium.plain:sheltering: While her cauldron is empty, she shelters behind it: some cards give more while it is Sheltering.
Extra.compendium.example:sheltering: Pot-Lid gives 5 Block, and 3 more while the cauldron is Sheltering — 8 with an empty pot.
Extra.compendium.plain:hidden_recipe: Three particular cards, brewed together, make something of their own that replaces the ordinary brew. Once found, it is written in the Recipe Book.
Extra.compendium.example:hidden_recipe: Adder's Nip, Nettle Tea and Mugwort Poultice brewed together are Snakebite Remedy, not an ordinary mixed brew.
Extra.compendium.plain:hearth_heal: Her Hearth healing restores only HP lost during the current fight — never the HP she came in without.
Extra.compendium.example:hearth_heal: She starts a fight on 60 of 70 and is hit for 5: Hearth healing can give back those 5, not the 10 before.
Extra.compendium.plain:hexed: A curse that counts to three: at the end of every third turn of the cursed enemy, it loses 3 HP for each Hexed. Hexed never fades, and more Hexed does not restart the count.
Extra.compendium.example:hexed: An enemy with 4 Hexed loses 12 HP at the end of its third turn, again at its sixth, and so on.
Extra.compendium.plain:misfortune: Bad luck waiting for the enemy's next action: 5 % per stack (at most 60 %) that the whole action fails. It is rolled once, then it is gone, whether it worked or not.
Extra.compendium.example:misfortune: An enemy with 6 Misfortune has a 30 % chance that its next attack simply does not happen.
Extra.compendium.plain:wand: The Apprentice's spell program: a row of slots. A card inscribed into it stays there, and every cast reads the slots in order, each card doing its Wand part.
Extra.compendium.example:wand: His wand holds Ink Blot, then Candle Stub. Casting it makes the Candle Stub's 4 damage 6, and both cards stay for the next cast.
Extra.compendium.plain:inscribe: His action, not a card: put a card from your hand into a free wand slot instead of playing it. The first each combat is free, every further one costs 1 Focus. It does not count as playing a card.
Extra.compendium.example:inscribe: He inscribes Candle Stub for free, then Flyleaf for 1 Focus: two cards in the wand, and no card played this turn.
Extra.compendium.plain:cast: His action: run the wand from its first slot to its last. It costs 2 Focus for 1–2 cards, 3 for 3–4, 4 for 5–6, and adds Exhaustion. At most three casts a turn.
Extra.compendium.example:cast: A wand of three cards costs 3 Focus. Cast it twice and it has cost 6, and its Exhaustion has risen twice.
Extra.compendium.plain:focus: What the wand runs on. Every card he plays gives 1 Focus (Junk gives none), up to 6, and it is kept from turn to turn.
Extra.compendium.example:focus: He plays Chalk Line and Candle Stub: 2 more Focus, enough to cast a two-card wand.
Extra.compendium.plain:wand_exhaustion: How strained the wand is. A cast adds 1, plus 1 for each heavy instruction (Echo, Shape, Keep, a reversal) and 1 more for five or more cards; Ground cards take some back. It may not go past 8, and falls by 3 at the start of every turn.
Extra.compendium.example:wand_exhaustion: Ink Blot → Candle Stub → Flyleaf adds 3 Exhaustion: 1, the Echo, and the copy it makes.
Extra.compendium.plain:burn_out: His action, once per turn while the wand has Exhaustion: Exhaust one wand card and lower Exhaustion by 3.
Extra.compendium.example:burn_out: With Exhaustion at 7 he burns out a spent Chalk Line: Exhaustion 4, and one slot free.
Extra.compendium.plain:speak: The wand part that does something: damage, Block, Ward Wax or a status. Most other wand parts change the Speak after them or copy the one before.
Extra.compendium.example:speak: Candle Stub's Wand part is a Speak: deal 4 damage.
Extra.compendium.plain:wand_modifiers: Heighten makes the next Speak bigger, Echo repeats the last one smaller, Shape changes how the next one lands (split, joined, spread, turned to Block), Clause adds to the next one when a condition holds.
Extra.compendium.example:wand_modifiers: Split Wick before Candle Stub: its 4 damage lands as two hits of 3, and each hit can spend a Singe.
Extra.compendium.plain:wand_order: Order moves the instructions about, Keep saves a Speak for later, Ground lowers this cast's Exhaustion, Burn does something once and is exhausted, Stop ends the cast early.
Extra.compendium.example:wand_order: Penny Whistle after Candle Stub stops the cast there: the cards after it do not run and are not paid for.
Extra.compendium.plain:fizzle: A wand part with nothing to act on does nothing — an Echo with no Speak before it, a Heighten with none after. The cast shows it before you pay.
Extra.compendium.example:fizzle: Flyleaf in the first slot fizzles: there is no Speak before it to repeat.
Extra.compendium.plain:singe: Kindling on an enemy: each direct hit spends 1 Singe and deals 2 more damage, before Block. Status damage never spends it.
Extra.compendium.example:singe: An enemy with 2 Singe is hit twice for 3: each hit deals 5, and the Singe is gone.
Extra.compendium.plain:flow: Stored ease for the wand: after a cast, the Flow you had when it began gives back that much of its Focus cost, and is spent.
Extra.compendium.example:flow: With 2 Flow he casts a 3-Focus wand: afterwards 2 Focus come back and the Flow is gone.
Extra.compendium.plain:grit: Each enemy Attack hit spends 1 Grit and deals 2 less — before Block, so it works however much Block there is.
Extra.compendium.example:grit: With 2 Grit, an enemy's two hits of 6 deal 4 each.
Extra.compendium.plain:gust: At the start of your next turn, after the draw, draw that many more cards and then discard as many.
Extra.compendium.example:gust: With 1 Gust he draws six, keeps the best five and discards one.
Extra.compendium.plain:authority: What the Lieutenant earns by keeping her word: each kept Order or Challenge gives 1 (some give 2). Cards spend it. She holds at most 6, it does not fade, and it is gone when the fight ends.
Extra.compendium.example:authority: She keeps First Orders: 1 Authority. Signal spends it for 1 Energy.
Extra.compendium.plain:order: A promise about her own actions, shown on her as a chip: what it asks, by when, and what it pays. She holds one at a time (two with Chain of Command); a new one replaces the old without failing it. The card that issues it never counts toward it.
Extra.compendium.example:order: First Orders: play a Deed later this turn. First Orders and then Watch Cut keeps it; ending the turn without a Deed fails it.
Extra.compendium.plain:challenge: A promise about one enemy, shown on that enemy. Most must be kept before it acts. She has one Challenge at a time; a new one withdraws the old. If the enemy falls first, the target is lost — not a failure.
Extra.compendium.example:challenge: Marked Man: hit it with Deeds twice more before it acts. Pike Butt's two hits keep it.
Extra.compendium.plain:open_guard: Exposure she takes on purpose. The next enemy Attack hit on her deals 25% more per stack (rounded down, at least 1), before Block, and spends all of it. Unused, it lapses at the start of her turn. It is not a debuff: nothing cleanses it.
Extra.compendium.example:open_guard: With 2 Open Guard, an attack of 6 hits her for 10; behind 10 Block it costs her nothing.
Extra.compendium.plain:spend_strength: Some of her cards spend Strength — only Strength she really has. What is spent is gone, and hits after it in the same card are weaker.
Extra.compendium.example:spend_strength: Heave at 3 Strength: 8 + 3, then spend 2 for 8 + 1.
Extra.tutorial:welcome: Welcome to the Old City Offices
Extra.tutorial.text:welcome: Three short rooms — two fights and a rest — show you how this character plays. Follow the notes; you can skip the tutorial at any time.
Extra.tutorial.text:map: This is the act's map. Each room is a symbol — a fight, an event, a shop, a rest — and the legend says which is which. In a real run you choose your own path between them; press M at any time to look.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.hand: These are your cards. Click one to play it. A card that needs a target is aimed: click it, then click an enemy. Right-click puts it back.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.energy: The number with the lightning bolt is your Energy. Each card costs what is printed in its top-left corner. You get your Energy back every turn.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.intent: Under every enemy is its intent: the move's name, then what it does. ⚔ 6 means it will hit you for 6 when you end your turn. Hover it for details.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.block: Block cards give you a shield for this round: damage takes Block before HP. "Incoming" under your health shows how much would get through right now.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.endturn: When you have played what you want, press End turn (or E). The enemies act, then you draw a new hand.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.statuses: The small chips under a body are statuses — Paperwork, Doubt and many more. The number is how much. Hover any of them to read what it does; a chip lights up when it changes.
Extra.tutorial.text:act3.docket: Every party here lives under customary law. Each enemy's chip names its own law; break it and you owe that party a Trespass. Three Trespass to one party become its Claim. A Safe-Conduct refuses one Trespass.
Extra.tutorial.text:act4.labyrinth: The road to the Judgment of the Dead. Burdened: every card costs 1 more until the surcharge is paid. A Scale weighs your turn: as many Deeds as Workings earns a Feather, anything else 1 Burdened. Canopic jars give their master powers until you break them, and the Risen get up once more. Entombed, from the elites on: at 5 you lose a turn.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.relics: The little tiles above you are your relics. They work on their own; a relic lights up when it triggers. Hover one to read it.
Extra.tutorial.text:reward: After a fight you get gold, and you may take one of three cards into your deck — or skip. A smaller deck draws its best cards more often. Right-click a card to see its improved version.
Extra.tutorial.text:combat.multiple: Now there are two. Pick a card, then click the enemy you want it to hit. The arrow keys aim, Space plays.
Extra.tutorial.text:rest: Rest to heal, or improve one card for good. If nothing can be improved, the button says so.
Extra.tutorial.text:compendium: Every effect and status in the game is explained in the Compendium, with an example. Open it from the title screen or with Esc during a run.
Extra.tutorial.text:complete: That is how this character fights. A real run is five acts: you choose your path on the map, and meet events (?), shops, elites and a boss at the end of every act — each explains itself. Good luck.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.cauldron: Your cauldron hangs under you. Drag a card from your hand onto it to put it in instead of playing it — the first each turn is free, every further one costs 1 Energy. A card in the pot is not played.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.shelter: While the cauldron is empty, you shelter behind its lid: cards like Pot-Lid give more Block then. Under the pot it says its state — Sheltering, Brewing or Ready.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.families: Every one of your cards is an ingredient of one family: Fang (damage), Hex (Hexed), Husk (Block), Hearth (healing) or Fortune (Misfortune). Its chip in the pot wears its family's colour.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.brew: With three in the pot, click it to Brew (1 Energy). Three of one family make a strong concentrated brew; any other mix gives what each ingredient gives. The pot shows what it is about to make. Then the ingredients go to your discard pile and the pot is empty again.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.hexed: Hexed does not fade. Every third enemy turn it bursts: the enemy loses 3 HP for each Hexed. Pile it on before the third night.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.misfortune: Misfortune is a chance that the enemy's next action fails: 5 % per stack, at most 60 %. It is rolled once, before that action, and then it is gone.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.hearth: Your healing only gives back HP lost in THIS fight — never more than you began it with. Heal when it hurts, not before.
Extra.tutorial.text:witch.recipes: Some exact mixes of three cards are Hidden Recipes with effects of their own. Brew one and it is written into your Recipe Book — the Recipes button beside End turn.
Extra.tutorial.text:ap.wand: Your staff has four slots. Drag a card from your hand onto a slot to inscribe it instead of playing it; it stays there. Click the staff to cast: the whole wand runs, slot by slot, each card doing its Wand part.
Extra.tutorial.text:ap.focus: The wand runs on Focus. Every card you play gives 1 Focus (at most 6), kept from turn to turn. A cast costs 2 Focus for one or two wand cards, more for longer wands.
Extra.tutorial.text:ap.cast: Your wand holds a card: click the staff to cast. Modifiers like Heighten change the Speak after them, so order matters: drag a slot onto another to swap them, or off the staff to withdraw it.
Extra.tutorial.text:ap.exhaustion: Each cast adds Exhaustion. At the limit the wand will not cast; it falls by 3 at the start of your turn. Right-click a slot to Burn Out when you need room.
Extra.tutorial.text:ap.elements: Singe on an enemy makes each direct hit deal more and is spent; Grit softens enemy hits; Flow refunds Focus after a cast; Gust lets you draw and discard next turn.
Extra.tutorial.text:lt.authority: You earn Authority by keeping your word — each kept Order or Challenge gives 1. Cards like Signal spend it. You hold at most 6, and it is gone when the fight ends.
Extra.tutorial.text:lt.order: An Order is a promise about your own actions, shown on you: what it asks and by when. First Orders: play a Deed later this turn. The card that issues it never counts.
Extra.tutorial.text:lt.challenge: A Challenge is a promise about one enemy, shown on it — most must be kept before that enemy acts. Watch Cut deals 2 more to a Challenged enemy.
Extra.tutorial.text:lt.open_guard: Open Guard is risk you take on purpose: the next enemy hit deals 25% more per stack (rounded down, at least 1), before Block, and spends it. Enough Block makes it cost nothing.
Extra.tutorial.text:lt.strength: Strength makes every hit stronger — and some of your cards can spend it for something else, like Armguard's Ward Wax. Only Strength you really have can be spent.
Extra.unlock.hint:sorcerers_apprentice: Defeat the Act I boss to unlock.
Extra.unlock.hint:hedge_witch: Defeat the Act II boss as the Sorcerer's Apprentice to unlock.
Extra.unlock.hint:bureaucrat: Defeat the Act III boss as the Hedge Witch to unlock.

Acts.NameKey: Act I: The Old City Offices
